concept.title: People with housing needs
concept.shortdesc: People looking for, struggling to keep, or at risk of losing a home, along with housing-related phrases such as landlords and residential properties.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: people at risk of losing their home
people with support needs to keep a tenancy
people who share or rent homes
people who are homeless: see (already without a home)
people living independently in their own homes: see (need support to stay at home rather than housing help)
residents of a local area: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (defined by where they live, not by a housing need)

section.title: Evidence and status

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed. The group re-formed in most resamplings of the data (stability 0.83).

Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. Split into people seeking housing or at risk of losing their home, and a separate group for landlords, property owners and residential properties or buildings.

section.p: Identifier in this run: aud-084. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
